structure: Part 13, Dashboard. Read in full at commit 04a073b: the five DR2.1 dashboard views (dashboard-home.html 136 lines, the overall home at /design-release-2.1/; dashboard.html 254 lines, the notifications list at /live-animals and /germinal-products; dashboard-actions.html 114 lines at /actions; dashboard-changes.html 53 lines at /changes; dashboard-inspection.html 120 lines at /inspection), the notification card macro partials/design-release-2.1/dashboard-notification-card.html (73 lines), the seeded list app/data/dashboard-notifications.js (16 notifications, page size 8, four sort options), and the routes.js ranges the partition names: 6610-6902 (list, actions and inspection page hrefs and pagination, the two dashboard categories, list path, changes sections, delay filter, date format), 7107-7675 (view, copy and delete hrefs, delete, arrival date format, commodity and quantity labels, enrichDesignRelease2Notification with its demo index overrides, getDashboardNotificationList, results text, sort items), 8667-8926 (date range, type and status filter items, getDashboardViewModel, renderOverallDashboardPage, renderDashboardPage), 9020-9123 (actions, changes and inspection view models and renders) and the GET handlers for /, /live-animals, /germinal-products, /actions, /changes, /inspection and /dashboard. To read what the pages show, it also looked (without claiming their own pages) at helpers outside the ranges: toDesignReleaseDashboardReference (routes.js:306), mapStatusTextToReviewVariant (5632), the action-required error message helpers (6371-6397), getDashboardBackLink (7093), the version mount's path prefixing (app/lib/version-mount.js:11-117) and app/data/dashboard-notification-snapshots.js (the action-required snapshot has no documents). Claims run: overall home (headings, messages link, buttons, three service sections and their glance cards with fixed counts and links); routes and redirects; list page (back link, success banner, heading by category, buttons, Summary glance cards, search, sort, additional filters with date range radios, date pickers, type and status selects, tabs, section subheadings, pagination, absence of results text and empty state); notification card (every field, status tag or text, error marker and message, Copy as new and View links, inspection tag; delete and amend not shown); actions, changes and inspection pages (heading, caption, description, details, search, sort, results text, sections, pagination, back links); and the seeded notifications as a fresh DR2.1 session shows them (tab membership, action, status-change and inspection selections). Templates are part 14's.

claims.statement: Status text maps to variants: 'submitted' to submitted; 'submission complete', 'complete' or 'completed' to completed; 'submitted action required' or 'action required' to action required; anything else (including 'draft', 'new', 'in progress') to draft.

The prototype fakes dashboard states by a notification's position in its list: non-draft, non-completed notifications at positions 2, 8, 14 and 20 become 'Action required'; position 4 becomes a 'needs inspection' status change, 7 'passed inspection', 11 'delayed'; and positions 5, 10, 16, 17, 22 and 23 are chosen for inspection.
